translation: after-dinner sociability, time spent at the table after a meal
examples: Después de cenar, nos quedamos en la sobremesa contando historias.
After dinner, we stayed awhile at the table, telling stories.
La sobremesa fue larga y divertida, y nadie tenía prisa.
The after-dinner conversation was long and lively, and nobody was in a hurry.
Me encanta la sobremesa tranquila con café y postre.
I love the calm after-dinner time with coffee and dessert.
